test_case.test_name: Parameterized authenticated AMD driver installation and eight-GPU activation validation
test_case.purpose: Install the approved AMD GPU driver stack through its complete vendor transaction and verify the intended loaded version binds every expected GPU after any required reboot.
required_package: Signed AMD/ROCm driver repository or package set, checksum, target version and license
Supported OS release, kernel, firmware and eight-GPU BDF/device-ID topology matrix
Vendor install command/options, dependency policy and complete log location
Approved reboot window, OOB access, rollback package/procedure and service restoration
Expected per-BDF driver/module, PCIe link and GPU health oracle
test_case.test_command: After artifact, compatibility and rollback approval, capture current packages/modules/BDF bindings, execute the exact vendor installation procedure with complete logs, perform only the approved reboot if required, then prove target package and loaded module versions plus stable per-BDF binding/PCIe visibility and health for all eight expected GPUs. Do not substitute read-only `rocm-smi` for the install transaction.
test_case.expected_result: The authenticated target packages install without unresolved errors, the target driver is actually loaded after the approved boot boundary, all eight expected BDFs bind correctly with expected PCIe visibility, and no new GPU/XID/IOMMU/kernel/BMC fault appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires artifact identity, full successful package transaction, loaded-version evidence and complete stable eight-GPU BDF/health validation. Version output alone or eight generic card indices cannot pass.
safety_gate: Explicit approval is required before package, module or reboot changes.
Verify OS/kernel/firmware compatibility and a tested rollback/OOB path first.
Do not unload an in-use driver; inventory GPU processes and dependent services.
Abort on repository/package mismatch, dependency removal outside scope, partial transaction, failed module load, missing BDF or lost access; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Source Key/Variant ID and separate duplicate-row identity
Signed artifact/checksum, compatibility matrix and approved command
Pre/post package, module and boot identity plus complete install log
Eight-GPU BDF/device/driver/link inventory and ROCm health output
Kernel/XID/IOMMU/BMC logs, service restoration and rollback readiness
test_case.recovery: On failure, preserve package-manager, module, boot and per-BDF evidence, do not repeat installation automatically, and execute only the pre-approved rollback from OOB/recovery access. Revalidate all eight GPUs and services after rollback.
